card.name: Start of an s-word after a hyphen
card.fires_on: A lone "s" or "S" (often after a hyphen) that begins a word, such as the "s" in long-sleeved, short-sleeve or temperature-sensing. It also fires on a capital S opening a new word such as Schedules or Sessile.
